messages:
camila: Heads up — mic on the podium is dropping intermittently during the fireside. Audio level spikes then silence for ~3s. Recording shows a glitch. Anyone on AV can triage?

sahil: I’m watching the stream now. Seeing same gaps in the OBS feed. Looks like room mic flips to 0dB for a sec then back.

maya: Can we switch presenter to the lav mic as a quick mitigation? Pulling lav now.

ops-bot: deploy-notify: recording-bucket backup complete (s3://redwood-recordings/allhands/3887654321).

camila: Quick checklist to swap without resuming the speaker: 1) mute podium channel in OBS 2) enable lav on input 3) send local stream a short mute/unmute 4) note timestamps for splice.

sahil: Doing that. OBS: muted "Room Podium" source, enabled "Lav Camila". Starting a 10s test tone to confirm.

chris-platform: If we need a cleaner recording later we can do an in-place splice from backup and append presenter audio. QA will need the exact cut points. Capture the console log and the raw wav from the recorder.

camila: Test tone ok, lav is stable. Can someone flag when the next silence happens so we can mark edit points?

maya: Marking in the watch doc: https://docs.redwood.internal/allhands/3887654321-watchlog — adding note: 00:12:15 sudden drop, swapped to lav at 00:12:27.

linda-ceo: Thanks for the quick swap team. For Q&A — please surface any leadership follow-ups in the backlog doc rather than DMs so SRE/product can pick them up. Also want a one-sentence summary of why the mic failed for the postmortem.

camila: Will add a postmortem note. Preliminary note: intermittent AGC bug on podium preamp causing momentary cutouts when ambient noise hits threshold.

chris-platform: For the editors: grabbed raw recorder: recorder_node:/mnt/rec/3887654321_camila_lav.wav and the obs log: /var/log/obs/3887654321-obs.log. Pasting the relevant snippet here for quick triage:

```
[12:12:15] audio_input: podium_preamp AGC engage -> gain -inf (cut)
[12:12:15] obs: source 'Room Podium' silence detected -> transition to 0
[12:12:27] audio_input: lav_connected -> gain stable +3dB
```

maya: Editors — please coordinate with camila for splice points, we have backup video+slides so should be straightforward.

camila: Also a quick ask for follow-ups: can we get a timeline for the Dedicated rollout question from the Q&A? @linda-ceo said you'd cover that.

linda-ceo: Yes — I'll post a short note in the backlog doc by EOD with next steps and owners.

camila: Awesome. One more ops ask — if you see any residual echo in the recording after the splice, consider a short notch + ducking instead of re-record. Editors, file action: "splice + noise gate".

sahil: Got it. I’ll keep monitoring until the end. If anything else drops I’ll ping here and add timestamps. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: reminder: postmortem template created at /playbooks/postmortems/allhands-audio-3887654321.md

camila: Thanks all — closing thread once editors confirm splice scheduled.
